meta_data.base_class: Retrieve detailed information about <public transportation> based on departure and destination cities - refers to long-distance public transport that requires booking.

tool_template.name: get_<class>_details
tool_template.description: Retrieve <class> details based on origin and destination.

departure_time.description: The scheduled departure time for the <class>, formatted as HH:MM.

arrival_time.description: The estimated arrival time for the <class>, formatted as HH:MM.

travel_class.description: The type of <class> service (e.g., economy, business, first class).

availability_status.description: The current booking status of the <class>, such as 'available', 'fully booked', or 'waitlisted'.

duration.description: The total travel time of the <class> in minutes.
